retail_vs_institutional_positioning.retail_positioning_summary: Across Reddit (r/wallstreetbets, r/stocks, r/options), X (FinTwit), and Stocktwits, retail trader sentiment is highly vocal and energized (+78% bullish sentiment skew). Retail investors are heavily trading Robinhood's newly launched presidential prediction markets and praising the rollout of Robinhood Legend desktop platform and 3% cash-back Gold Cards. However, retail derivatives activity shows noticeable caution: having seen HOOD fall on Day 1 in each of the last 4 earnings cycles despite beats, retail option traders are buying downside puts and bear straddles as a tactical hedge against a post-earnings volatility crush. With weekly straddles pricing ±10.13% (±$9.73/sh) and Put/Call OI ratio at 1.15, options flow reflects healthy pre-print hedging.
retail_vs_institutional_positioning.institutional_positioning_summary: Sell-side desks (30 analysts covering, Buy rating 1.69 consensus, mean price target $134.90 / +40.4% upside from $96.08, high target $170.00 from top brokers) view Robinhood as transitioning from a retail trading portal into a diversified next-generation neo-custodian alongside Schwab and Interactive Brokers. Institutional buy-side whisper bogeys stand at $1,460M for Q3 revenue and $0.60 for Diluted EPS. Long/short hedge funds have initiated long equity positions paired with collar structures or short out-of-the-money call spreads to harvest elevated implied volatility (86.1% IV) while participating in potential multiple expansion if full-year operating expense guidance is lowered.
